summary: TestFlight Round-4 v2 STT bulletproofing (Bug 16 v2) + George voice consistency re-verify (Bug 15 v2). HONEST SCOPE: only CODE STRUCTURE + backend contract could be verified from this web-preview sandbox — actual iOS AVAudioRecorder lifecycle and cloud-TTS playback on Garry's iPhone CANNOT be exercised here. This report does NOT claim device-level pass. Backend + structural: 15/15 pytest PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_iter88_stt_bulletproofing_v2.py. Verified in VoiceInputButton.tsx beginCapture (L147-185): (1) 150ms warm-up sleep between prepareToRecordAsync() and record() at L163; (2) `recorder.isRecording === false` guard immediately after record() throws 'recorder failed to start' at L168-170; (3) hardened friendly-error copy "Sorry, I couldn't start recording. Please try again in a moment." at L181 with no raw JSON leak; ordering setAudioModeAsync → prepareToRecordAsync → 150ms sleep → record() is correct. Bug 15 v2: GeorgeRemembersBanner.tsx L25 imports GeorgeSpeakButton and L144 renders `<GeorgeSpeakButton text={spokenText} …/>`; no legacy device-TTS `<SpeakButton>` remains. Correctly scoped: only George surfaces (GeorgeRemembersBanner, GeorgeOnboarding) use cloud TTS; recipes/[id], (tabs)/home, notices, dm/[id] and all games still import the device-TTS `SpeakButton` — matches Garry's 'cloud voice for George only' spec. Backend /api/voice/transcribe still returns 422 on empty POST (contract unchanged). app.json pins remain 1.0.12 / iOS build 119 / Android versionCode 119 — NOT modified. Frontend live-smoke on 375x667: Welcome screen ('FriendPlace / Because you belong too.') renders cleanly, no red screen, only pre-existing legacy warnings (shadow*/textShadow*/pointerEvents/useNativeDriver) unrelated to these fixes.

react_native_issues.issue: Legacy web-preview console warnings only. Harmless on native iOS build. Unrelated to Round-4 v2 fixes. Reference: pre-existing across the app.

action_items: DEVICE-TEST REQUIRED (cannot be automated here): (a) Install build 119 on Garry's iPhone. Tap the mic on a text input, speak 2-3 seconds, tap to stop. EXPECTED: transcript appears in the input. If the 0-byte issue recurs, the new 150ms warm-up + isRecording guard should now surface the warm sentence 'Sorry, I couldn't start recording. Please try again in a moment.' rather than a raw JSON error. (b) Open the George Remembers banner on Home; tap the speaker icon. EXPECTED: cloud voice (OpenAI onyx/nova via /api/mcgs/george/speak) plays — NOT the Apple robotic voice. If cloud fetch fails, the button shows a toast 'Could not play George's voice. Please try again.' with no device-TTS fallback (by design).

If STT still records 0-byte audio on the iPhone even with the 150ms warm-up + isRecording guard, the next escalation is either (i) explicitly polling `recorder.isRecording` for up to ~500ms after record() before starting the tick timer, or (ii) discarding the first 200ms of the buffer via a minimum-duration guard (already partially covered by the 500-byte blob-size gate).
critical_code_review_comments: VoiceInputButton.tsx L147-185 beginCapture: chain is setAudioModeAsync → prepareToRecordAsync → 150ms sleep → record() → isRecording===false guard (throws) → set 'recording' state + tick timer + 60s auto-stop. Order is correct; catch on L179-183 surfaces the warm copy and never leaks raw JSON.
VoiceInputButton.tsx L94-97: BACKEND_URL uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL || EXPO_BACKEND_URL — Metro-inlinable, no `(process.env as any)` cast. Good — was the round-2 fix for native builds.

GeorgeRemembersBanner.tsx L25/L144: cloud TTS wired correctly; only George-attributed content triggers it (spokenText = visible.content, i.e. the George-authored 'thinking ahead' / 'just checking in' message).

Non-George surfaces (app/dm/[id].tsx, app/recipes/[id].tsx, app/notices.tsx, app/(tabs)/home.tsx, all game screens) continue to use SpeakButton (device TTS) — the George-only scoping spec is respected.

rca_of_issue: PRIOR FALSE-POSITIVE RCA: Iterations 85-87 verified code structure (imports, string literals, method presence) but did not — and could not from a web preview — verify runtime AVAudioRecorder behaviour or cloud-TTS audio playback on a physical iPhone. That is why Garry saw 'verified fixed' 3× while the bug persisted on-device. Iter88 explicitly labels the scope: structural + backend contract PASS; device runtime UNVERIFIABLE HERE. The three new defensive changes address the KNOWN iOS record() lifecycle issues (warm-up race, silent-start, raw-error leak) but MUST be confirmed on build 119 on Garry's device before shipping.
